description: This file defines a wizard interface for generating an XML file for VAT intra-community reporting in the Odoo ERP system. It includes form definitions, methods for retrieving European countries, and XML creation logic.

classes.name: parter_vat_intra
classes.description: A wizard interface class for creating VAT intra XML files in Odoo.

methods.name: _get_europe_country
methods.description: Retrieves a list of European country IDs based on country codes.

methods.name: _create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML file for VAT intra-community reporting, encodes it in base64, and prepares it for download.
